//: Every page of the module lives in this one flow, matching the O2C main
application. The earlier structure gave each page its own flow, which is
why nothing rendered: the shell hosts a single router outlet, so pages in
eleven sibling flows had nowhere to be drawn. One flow, one outlet.
defaultPage is the login. checkSessionChain on the shell replaces it with
the role's landing page as soon as a valid session is found, so a user with
a live token never sees it.
description: O2C Timesheet Module - all pages, hosted by the shell's router outlet.
